lines.C02: [sly, confiding] You say I eat too much. {{pause=0.6}} [airy, dismissive] Of course, that's not true. {{pause=0.6}} [casual, grand] Every day I feast in front of the court. {{pause=0.5}} [wry] Today... before your eyes.
lines.C03: [imperious] Bow. {{pause=0.2}} Lower. {{pause=0.2}} [approving] Good. {{pause=0.6}} [matter-of-fact] Anyone dressed properly may come in. {{pause=0.5}} [dry, eyeing the viewer] Most of you. {{pause=0.7}} [inviting, grand] Come, I'll show you my dinner.
lines.C04: [bossy] Marcel, show them the room. {{pause=0.7}} [casual] Duchesses sit. Everyone else stands. {{pause=0.7}} [sharp, annoyed] Not my chin, Marcel.
lines.C05: [confiding, amused] My sister-in-law says I eat four bowls of soup. {{pause=1.0}} [deadpan] She can't count.
lines.C06: [offhand, smug] A pheasant. A whole one. She wrote that too. {{pause=1.2}} [haughty, mildly offended] Someone taught the peasants to use a fork. {{pause=0.8}} [smug] I've untaught them. {{pause=0.9}} [whispering, pointing out] Look. {{pause=0.3}} Last week he had a silver fork.
lines.C07: [sly, to the viewer] Fork or fingers? Tell me in the comments. {{pause=0.8}} [sweetly menacing] Wrong answers go to the Bastille.
lines.C08: [dry] No glass on my table. {{pause=0.4}} I ask for a drink... {{pause=0.8}} [deadpan] and I get a little older.
lines.C09: [laughs warmly] Mon Dieu. {{pause=0.8}} [airy] Leave it. Nobody saw anything. {{pause=0.8}} [soft, cold] And nobody will see you again. {{pause=1.6}} [laughs] I'm joking.
lines.C10: [dry, praising] Well done, Marcel. Keep filming. {{pause=0.9}} [pleased] Salad. A whole bowl. {{pause=0.8}} [flat, menacing] Find out where he lives.
lines.C11: [hurt, quiet] Peas. A lady at court writes that nobody talks about anything else. {{pause=0.8}} Last year they talked about me. {{pause=1.2}} [dreamy, sinking into the chair] Ohh... {{pause=0.5}} I wasn't born to work. {{pause=0.6}} [sighing happily] I was born for happiness, love, pleasure... {{pause=0.4}} and a good rest. [laughs joyfully, delighted with his own witty line]
lines.C12: [calm, rhetorical] So. Do I eat too much? {{pause=0.8}} [grand] No. {{pause=0.5}} I eat exactly what a king should. {{pause=0.7}} [smug, imperious] Don't be afraid of getting fat. {{pause=0.5}} Be afraid of being a loser. {{pause=0.4}} [laughs, a cold, arrogant, haughty laugh, contemptuous]
lines.C13: [calm, grand] That button was a gift. {{pause=0.8}} [firm] The partridge, no. {{pause=1.4}} [dry] Neither have they. {{pause=0.6}} [magnanimous] Take a pea. One.
lines.C14: [mock-generous] Next time, my surgeon. He's been practising. {{pause=0.7}} [sly] On other people. {{pause=0.7}} [imperious, grand] Subscribe to my stunning channel.
lines.C01: [startled, then annoyed] Oops, the ceiling. {{pause=0.3}} [satisfied] There. {{pause=0.5}} [grand, formal] Bonjour. I am Louis, King of France. {{pause=0.3}} [proud] And this is my channel. {{pause=0.4}} [proud, drawling] They call me the Sun King. {{pause=0.5}} [delighted, self-admiring] Yes... I'm that handsome.
lines.BURST: [deadpan, calm voice-over] Four services. {{pause=0.4}} Every night.

marcel.C10: [nervous, reading out] Someone asks if you ever eat vegetables, Sire.
marcel.C13: [quiet, hungry] I haven't eaten since this morning.

cupbearer.C08: [loud, ceremonial, a servant calling] A drink for the King!
